caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum path depth. Progressive Infinite uses Russian Roulette and accumulates a new independent path every frame; 64 is only a GPU safety guard.
caustica.options.rt.sunSize.tooltip: Angular radius of the sun and moon disk. Larger discs cast softer shadow penumbrae.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Present in HDR (ST.2084/PQ) instead of SDR, when the display supports it. Takes effect after restarting the game.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: Absolute brightness (in nits) that SDR-equivalent scene brightness maps to on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Visualize an intermediate ray-tracing buffer instead of the final image.
caustica.options.rt.temporalDenoiser.too: Temporal reprojection denoiser using motion vectors. Blends frames over time while detecting disocclusion. Works on all GPUs.
caustica.options.rt.spatialDenoiser.tool: SVGF-style spatial denoiser. Edge-aware bilateral filter that removes residual noise while preserving sharp details.
caustica.options.rt.bmfrDenoiser.tooltip: Cross-vendor real-time BMFR denoising at native display resolution, preserving fine texture detail with color, depth, motion, normal, and albedo guides.
caustica.options.rt.nrdDenoiser.tooltip: Official NRD 4.17.3 Vulkan denoiser from NVIDIA's vk_denoise_nrd sample.
caustica.options.rt.nrdMethod.tooltip: ReLAX preserves detail, ReBLUR is more aggressive at low samples, and Reference is a slow stationary-camera accumulator.
caustica.options.rt.rayBudget.tooltip: Maximum primary-ray budget per render pixel. Lower values keep native render dimensions but trace a checkerboard/interlaced pattern without bilinear scaling. Enable Jitter to rotate the pattern every frame for better temporal convergence.
caustica.options.rt.oidnDenoiser.tooltip: High-quality Intel OIDN CPU denoiser using HDR color, albedo, and normal guides. Uses native resolution instead of DLSS-RR and has one frame of latency; slower than the real-time denoiser.
caustica.options.rt.oidnRealtimeDenoiser: Fast OIDN preview mode using the SDK's real-time quality preset at the selected realtime denoiser resolution, followed by GPU upscaling.
caustica.options.rt.realtimeDenoiserReso: Input resolution used by realtime OIDN and NVIDIA NRD. Lower values use fewer pixels. Ray Budget can additionally trace rotating interlaced phases without shrinking this resolution further.
caustica.options.rt.accumulation.tooltip: When enabled, frames are accumulated over time for a cleaner image (resets on camera movement). Disable for instant response.
caustica.options.rt.rayBudgetJitter.tool: Covers every native pixel over 2–16 dephased frames and jitters samples inside each pixel. Unsafe raw accumulation is bypassed to prevent stationary-camera history stretching.
